scope: J105 alternative research only; no substitution or manufacturing qualification
decision: Keep HANRUN HR911105A C12074. No verified drop-in replacement with a fully qualified supplier model was found among the candidates inspected.

candidates.model: Actual JLC 3D body and two purple markers visible. 2D and 3D inspection did not establish all signal/LED pins or the correct supplier anchor. A visible body is not full pin qualification.
candidates.electrical_note: Linked drawing page3 has the same logical pin1-12 signal/LED assignment as HR911105A; exact catalogue-to-drawing identity remains unconfirmed.
candidates.mechanical_note: Linked drawing p1: shield-hole spacing15.75mm vs HANRUN15.49mm; LED-to-locator row4.06mm vs4.90mm; locator drill3.20mm vs3.25mm. Cannot qualify as drop-in.

candidates.model: Not tested in PCBA viewer; rejected at electrical pinout stage. EasyEDA footprint availability alone is not assembly model proof.
candidates.rejection: Linked drawing p3 uses pin3 TX centre tap, pin6 RX centre tap, pins7/8 RX+/RX-. Existing board uses pin3 RX+,pin4 TX centre tap,pin5 RX centre tap,pin6 RX-. Not a direct replacement. PDF identity also differs from catalogue.
No assembly stock; catalogue offers consignment/request quote. No exact datasheet visible, and actual supplier model was not qualified.
Higher price and catalogue schematic has a different multi-pair/16-pin assignment. Not pursued as a drop-in; no supplier-model qualification.

cost_limit: Candidate prices are part-only observations. Sparse one-part preview is not a complete PCBA quote. Do not subtract its saving from the full cart as a final quotation.
next: Resolve existing J105 full pin/anchor/rotation with supplier. A replacement would require exact manufacturer drawing, footprint/pin verification, real placement preview, full BOM requote and review.
